items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are mostly clear, but exported API (NewEncryptor, EncryptWriter, DecryptReader, LoadKey, Config.Validate) has no doc comments. The unused `hmacHash func() []byte` field and the test leftover `_ = base64.StdEncoding` make the code harder to follow.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: encryption.go is 543 lines (>500 cap). LoadKey is about 85 lines and repeats the decode, length check and ErrInvalidKey wrap for env/file/literal. The hmacHash field is dead code. UnmarshalYAML with 3-4 alias keys per field is scope creep.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are wrapped with %w and constants are named. decodeBase64 quietly falls back across 4 encodings (lenient). LoadKey forces `cfg.Enabled = true`. Close does a runtime type assertion `ew.mac.(interface{ Sum... })` instead of a typed field. EncryptWriter defers init errors until Write.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: Mandated signatures changed and callers compile. storage.PathGenerator keeps its signature by hardcoding `false`. Unencrypted output is unchanged. Extra surface: a custom UnmarshalYAML accepting alias keys (key_source, key-source, source, ...) plus json tags.

validity_flags.basis: existing test lines changed/removed (4): fileutil/fileutil_test.go; existing test lines changed/removed (2): handler/jobhandler_test.go
